meta.notes: Complete 21-card base set. Data entered manually from physical card scans. All card images present in /public/cards/ as NNN.jpg (zero-padded card id). Master Crok (id 1) is a unique, groupless card. Captain Crok and Karate Crok abilities use the assumptions documented in their notes (per-player stat sum; power replacement).

abilityArchetypes.swap-from-hand: Replace played card with a chosen card from hand; reopens ability loop
abilityArchetypes.swap-from-deck-blind: Replace played card with top card of own deck without looking
abilityArchetypes.force-opponent-deck-swap: Force a chosen opponent to replace their played card with the bottom card of their deck
abilityArchetypes.change-stat-free: Change the declared battle stat to any of the three stats
abilityArchetypes.change-stat-to-power: Change the declared battle stat to power specifically
abilityArchetypes.immediate-nullify-all: Azonnal: immediately nullifies all opponents' abilities this battle
abilityArchetypes.immediate-nullify-group-or-draw: Azonnal: nullify abilities of a specific group OR draw a card (player chooses)
abilityArchetypes.copy-ability: Use the ability of a card from another player's loser pile
abilityArchetypes.recover-loser-to-hand: Take one of your own losing Croks back into your hand
abilityArchetypes.force-extra-battle: Everyone adds top deck card to the battle; sum of both cards' stat values is used
abilityArchetypes.force-opponent-discard: Target player must move a card from their hand to their loser pile
abilityArchetypes.buff-next-battle: All your Croks gain +1 to all stats in the next battle
abilityArchetypes.conditional-power-boost: This card gains +2 power if its intelligence is higher than all opponents'
abilityArchetypes.trigger-vakharc-on-loss: If this card loses, the next battle starts as a Vakharc and you choose the stat
abilityArchetypes.scale-with-opponents: All stats increase by the number of opponents; swapped Croks count as extra opponents
abilityArchetypes.attacker-plus-reflex: Become attacker next round AND gain +2 reflex when in defender role
abilityArchetypes.deficit-buff: Stats increase by how many more wins the chosen opponent has than you
abilityArchetypes.sacrifice-power: Discard a card from hand to your loser pile; use that card's power stat in this battle
abilityArchetypes.deck-scry: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and rearrange them in any order
abilityArchetypes.winning-override-copy: Wins the battle if you discard from hand a copy of any other player's played Crok
abilityArchetypes.winning-override-on-tie: Wins the battle if the stat comparison result is currently a tie

ability.name: Váratlan csapás
ability.textHu: Kicserélheted egy másik, a kezedben levő Crokra, ha az nem Master Crok.
ability.textEn: You may swap this for another Crok in your hand, as long as it is not Master Crok.
ability.notes: Cannot swap for another copy of Master Crok. Swapping reopens the ability loop. NOTE: Master Crok is a UNIQUE, GROUPLESS card (group: null) — it can never contribute toward a group-victory in the win condition.

ability.name: Trükkös fordulat
ability.textHu: Megváltoztathatod a harc típusát: erő, intelligencia vagy reflex.
ability.textEn: You may change the battle type: power, intelligence or reflex.
ability.notes: Can change to any stat including the already declared one (no-op). Rules text implies reactive play after opponent swaps.

ability.name: Lélekrablás
ability.textHu: Használhatja egy másik játékos, egyik vesztes Crokjának képességét.
ability.textEn: May use the ability of one of another player's losing Croks.
ability.notes: Target is ANY player's loser pile, not just the direct opponent. The borrowed ability is used in place of Devil Crok's own ability turn; counts as Devil's one use.

ability.name: Első vágás
ability.textHu: Azonnal hatástalanítja az ellenfelek képességeit.
ability.textEn: Immediately nullifies the opponents' abilities.
ability.notes: Azonnal: fires immediately at reveal, out of turn order. Nullifies ALL opponents' abilities for this battle. Does not affect Samurai's own ability (already used).

ability.name: Feltámasztás
ability.textHu: Visszaveheted a kezedbe egy vesztes Crokodat.
ability.textEn: You may take one of your losing Croks back into your hand.
ability.notes: Retrieves any card from your own loser pile back to hand. Does not affect win-condition group count (the recovered card was already in the loser pile).

ability.name: Nagy ütközet
ability.textHu: Útközetet indíthatsz: mindenki kiteszi paklijának legfelső Crokját, aki csatlakozik a harcolókhoz. Az értékek összege számít.
ability.textEn: You may start a Grand Battle: everyone places the top Crok of their deck face-down alongside their played Crok. The SUM of both Croks' stat values is compared for resolution.
ability.notes: OPEN QUESTION: does 'sum of values' mean (a) each player sums their two cards' chosen stat, then compares totals, or (b) the sum across all cards in play? Assumed (a). Players with empty decks contribute only their played card. The extra deck card does not trigger abilities.

ability.name: Nincs kegyelem
ability.textHu: A kiszemelt másik játékos választ és lerak egy lapot a vesztes Crokjaihoz.
ability.textEn: The targeted other player chooses a card from their hand and places it in their loser pile.
ability.notes: The TARGET player chooses which hand card to discard (not the Executor player). Reduces opponent's hand and may hurt their win-group count if they sacrifice a winner — but here it goes to LOSER pile from HAND, not from winner pile.

ability.name: Dzsungelharc
ability.textHu: Kicserélheted a paklid legfelső Crokjára, anélkül, hogy megnéznéd, hogy melyik az a lap.
ability.textEn: You may swap this for the top Crok of your deck without looking at which card it is.
ability.notes: Blind swap from own deck top. The new card's ability is available for use in the same battle (loop continues). If deck is empty, the ability cannot be used.

ability.name: Tanítás ereje
ability.textHu: A következő harcban Crokjaid minden értéke eggyel megnő.
ability.textEn: In the next battle, all of your Croks' stat values increase by one.
ability.notes: Persistent cross-battle buff: +1 to ALL three stats on whichever Crok you play next battle. Buff is on the PLAYER state, applied at the start of the next battle. Does not stack with multiple Sensei uses (TBD: clarify if it stacks).

ability.name: Lehengerlés
ability.textHu: Kettővel nő az ereje, ha intelligensebb, mint az ellenfelei.
ability.textEn: Its power increases by 2 if its intelligence is higher than all opponents'.
ability.notes: Condition: Sumo's intelligence (5) must exceed ALL opponents' intelligence stats. In N-player, must beat every other played card. Boost is +2 power for this battle only.

ability.name: Tömegverekedés
ability.textHu: Ha veszít, akkor a következő harc vakharccal indul, te választod meg a típusát.
ability.textEn: If this card loses, the next battle starts as a Vakharc (blind battle) and you choose the stat type.
ability.notes: Fires after resolution if Pancrator loses. Forces the next battle to begin in Vakharc state. The Pancrator owner (not the battle winner) declares the stat for that Vakharc. Ability is automatic if conditions are met.

ability.name: Sorozatlövés
ability.textHu: Az értékei annyival megnőnek, ahány ellenfele van. A kicserélt Crokok is újabb ellenfélnek számítanak.
ability.textEn: All stats increase by the number of opponents. Swapped Croks also count as additional opponents.
ability.notes: Base opponent count = (number of players - 1). Each card swap by any opponent during this battle adds +1 to the count. Count is locked when Army's ability resolves, not recalculated after.

ability.name: Pimasz csínytevés
ability.textHu: A következő körben te támadsz. Védekezéskor +2 reflex.
ability.textEn: In the next round you are the attacker. When defending in this battle, +2 reflex.
ability.notes: Dual effect: (1) sets you as attacker next round regardless of who wins, (2) +2 reflex buff applies THIS battle if you are a defender. If you are already the attacker, effect (2) does not apply.

ability.name: Dühöngés
ability.textHu: Annyival megnőnek az értékei, amennyivel kevesebb a nyertes lapod, mint a kiválasztott ellenfelednek.
ability.textEn: All stats increase by the amount that your win-pile count is lower than the chosen opponent's.
ability.notes: Cave chooses ONE opponent to compare against. Buff = max(0, opponent.winCount - own.winCount). If you are equal or ahead, buff is 0. Catch-up mechanic — strongest when behind.

ability.name: Van másik!
ability.textHu: Egy másik játékos Crokját kicseréltetheted paklijának legalsó lapjára.
ability.textEn: You may force another player to swap their played Crok for the bottom card of their deck.
ability.notes: Forces the bottom (not top) of target's deck — high disruption, unknown card. If the target's deck is empty, no swap occurs. The new card's ability is available in the continuing loop.

ability.name: Pajzsharc
ability.textHu: A harc típusát erőre változtathatod.
ability.textEn: You may change the battle type to power.
ability.notes: Restricted version of Bond's change-stat — can ONLY switch to power, not a free choice. Useful to guarantee a power-type battle.

ability.name: Felderítés
ability.textHu: Átnézheted a paklid felső 6 Crokját és megváltoztathatod a sorrendjüket.
ability.textEn: You may look at the top 6 Croks of your deck and rearrange them in any order.
ability.notes: Private information action: only the Indian owner sees the cards. Allows setting up future draws. If deck has fewer than 6 cards, look at all remaining cards.

ability.name: Tigriskarom
ability.textHu: Ha a vesztesek közé raksz egy Crokot a kezedből, akkor annak erejét használhatod a harcban.
ability.textEn: If you place a Crok from your hand into your loser pile, you may use that card's power stat in this battle.
ability.notes: OPEN QUESTION: does the sacrificed card's power REPLACE Karate's own power (2) or ADD to it? Assumed replace — 'use its power' implies substitution. Cost: the sacrificed card goes to loser pile permanently.

ability.name: Letartóztatás
ability.textHu: Nyer, ha a vesztesek közé dobod a kezedből bármelyik másik játékos Crokjának mását.
ability.textEn: Wins the battle if you discard from your hand a copy of any other player's played Crok into your loser pile.
ability.notes: Winning override: stat comparison is skipped entirely; Police wins. Requires holding a card with the SAME name as any other player's currently-played Crok. The copy goes to Police owner's loser pile as cost. Named in the official rules as the 'Police' winning ability.

ability.name: Ima
ability.textHu: Azonnal hatástalanítja a [ördög] Crokok képességeit, vagy húzhatsz egy lapot.
ability.textEn: Immediately nullifies all devil-group Croks' abilities, OR you may draw a card (your choice).
ability.notes: Azonnal: fires at reveal, out of turn order. Choice between two effects: (A) nullify devil-group abilities (Devil Crok, Executor Crok) for this battle, or (B) draw 1 card from deck. If no devil-group Croks are in play, option A is a no-op but still valid.

ability.name: Pisztolypárbaj
ability.textHu: Nyer, ha az aktuális eredmény döntetlen.
ability.textEn: Wins the battle if the current stat comparison result is a tie.
ability.notes: Player uses this during the ability phase after seeing all revealed cards. If the chosen stat is tied between all players, Sheriff wins instead of Vakharc triggering. Named in the official rules as a 'Sheriff' winning ability.
